text:
Nia (AE): FYI new POC inbound from Asteria Labs. They want a 30-day Dedicated POC, customer-managed keys (Thales), SCCs in DPA, and net45 invoicing. Need order form signed before provisioning.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Can we get expected concurrency/peak? that determines Dedicated pool size + whether we can promise burst capacity.
Ava (Customer): @Nia - baseline 40 qps, peaks 150 qps; model family: rtx-6b-quantized, avg seq 800. We'll provide a sample PO.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Good — that fits our small Dedicated tier but KMS onboarding needed. We'll need the key wrap flow and provisioning steps.
Priya (Legal): Looping in Legal. For SCCs we need counterparty legal entity and invoicing address. Also flag: "no subprocessor" is negotiable but broad exclusion is risky. Ask them to propose specific subprocessor constraints.
Nia (AE): Asteria legal entity: Asteria Labs, Inc. Billing address: 12 Alder St, Dublin, IE. VAT: IE1234567. They prefer DocuSign with two signers (procurement + legal).
Kunal (Finance): Net45 OK for enterprise but route to revenue ops for approval once PO & billing entity verified. Multiple signers fine, we just need invoice remit-to details. Also confirm currency (EUR vs USD).
Ava (Customer): Currency: EUR acceptable. We'll include remit-to info in the PO.
sec-bot: Security ticket created: SECQ-9017. Required evidence: Thales attestation, integration diagram, key lifecycle. Due 72 hours.
Priya (Legal): On HSM attestation: ask them to provide the exact attestation language. We typically can reference KMS/HSM support but a 3rd-party attestation clause may require security artifacts.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist: (1) Dedicated capacity estimate, (2) KMS key policy + provisioning doc, (3) network allowlist for their IPs or VPC peering. Estimate: 6 business days to provision once OF signed + keys present.
Nia (AE): I'll request PO and their DPA redlines. Priya - should they upload redlines as tracked PDF or bullets?
Priya (Legal): Tracked changes PDF preferred. If they can't, numbered redline list OK. We'll review SCC insertion points and the no-subprocessor ask.
Kunal (Finance): Reminder: VAT handling for EU invoicing — need VAT ID validation. If EUR invoicing, convert to USD in our ledger; confirm their bank wiring or ACH capabilities.
Ava (Customer): We'll send PO + tracked redlines by Monday EOD. Also confirm: can we get the SLA latency number added to the order form?
Omar (Solutions Eng): We can add per-route latency targets in OF but SLA escalation path must reference Support tier. We'll propose a POC SLA: 99.5% availability, target p99 latency < 250ms for 512 tokens.
Priya (Legal): OK to include SLA targets but tie to support-level credits. We'll draft a short SLA clause for POC.
sec-bot: SECQ-9017 updated: request uploaded (Thales attestation, diagram). Due in 48 hours.
Nia (AE): Great. Action items: 1) I'll upload PO + tracked redlines when received. 2) @Omar to draft capacity + KMS onboarding steps. 3) @Priya to prepare initial DPA response and provisional SLA language. 4) @Kunal to flag VAT/finance steps.
Kunal (Finance): I'll prepare the payment-term exception docs and revenue ops contact.
Priya (Legal): Will triage on receipt; if they insist on "no subprocessor" we may propose a notification + objection window instead.
Omar (Solutions Eng): One technical Q for customer: do you require key escrow or rotation frequency specifics?
Ava (Customer): No escrow. Rotation: annual minimum. We'll include that in the PO.
Nia (AE): Thanks team. I'll ping when PO + redlines in. :pray:
